title:
Power Steering Pump
REMOVAL OF POWER STEERING PUMP

content.description: Overall view of power steering pump assembly showing drive belt and pulley, pressure tube, air control hose, return hose, and power steering pump mounted on engine

items: DISCONNECT AIR HOSES FROM AIR CONTROL VALVE
DISCONNECT RETURN HOSE FROM RESERVOIR TANK

DISCONNECT PRESSURE TUBE FROM POWER STEERING PUMP
Using SST, loosen and disconnect the pressure tube.
SST 09631-20020

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to disconnect pressure tube from power steering pump

items: (a) Push on the drive belt to hold the pulley in place and remove the pulley set nut.
(b) Remove the drive belt adjust bolt.
(c) Remove the PS pump rear mount bolt.
(e) Remove the pulley and woodruff key.

content.description: Illustration of power steering pump with drive belt and pulley

items:
REMOVE POWER STEERING PUMP
Remove the PS pump front mount bolt, and remove the PS pump.
